queries_run: Teledyne Technologies export control OR entity list China unreliable entity list 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：中國將包含兩家 Teledyne 法人實體列入不可靠實體清單或出口管制清單，並限制鎵、鍺等材料出口，已影響部分數位影像與航太國防產品的生產與定價。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: In response, China has unveiled restrictions on exports from China of certain materials and components, including gallium and germanium and which are used in semiconductor manufacturing and permanent magnets and which have impacted 9 Table of Contents the production and pricing of some of our digital imaging and aerospace and defense products. China has also increased sanctions on certain specific U.S. companies, including two Teledyne legal entities, by adding them to its Unreliable Entity List or Export Control List

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：關稅仍有效，中國限制稀土出口；公司稱製造據點分散於多國可緩解部分關稅衝擊，並可能以調價因應。
findings.excerpt: Our manufacturing facilities span across many countries which helps us mitigate the impact of certain tariffs and trade restrictions. Also, consistent with our strategy, we continually optimize our operations and take measures to contain costs to reduce the impact from tariffs. We may also implement additional pricing actions to mitigate the impact of these tariffs.

findings.claim: 10-K：公司曾就 Teledyne FLIR 自非美國轄區出貨、de minimis 計算方式錯誤導致未取得許可，向美國國務院與商務部 BIS 自願揭露。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We have made other voluntary disclosures to the U.S. Department of State and the U.S. Department of Commerce, including to the Bureau of Industry and Security (“BIS”) with respect to Teledyne FLIR shipments of products from non-U.S. jurisdictions which were not licensed due to incorrect de minimis calculation methodology under the Export Administration Regulations.

reg_tariff_export.note: Section 232 專項搜尋未找到點名 TDY 的來源。搜尋摘要顯示 Q2 2026 財報電話會議提到關稅退款一次性效益約 $10M，及鍺與稀土磁鐵供應疑慮，列為線索待程式核實；另有 2025-10-09 中國將 Teledyne FLIR 列入不可靠實體清單（Q3 2025 電話會議稱影響預期輕微），未取得可逐字引用原文。

clues.claim: Q2 2026 財報電話會議：關稅退款使利潤率受惠，淨一次性效益約 $10M，主要在 Digital Imaging；管理層並提及關稅變動、鍺與稀土磁鐵供應疑慮。
clues.source: MarketBeat Teledyne Q2 earnings call highlights

clues.claim: 中國商務部 2025-10-09 將 Teledyne FLIR 等 14 家外國實體列入不可靠實體清單。
clues.source: Bloomberg Law: China Adds More Foreign Entities to Unreliable Entity List
